technical_body.trigger: STA associates to any AP in a Mobility Domain for the first time
technical_body.keying: runs a normal 4-way handshake; derives PMK-R0 (per mobility domain) and PMK-R1 (per BSSID)
artifacts: MDE (IE 54) in beacon confirms FT capability

technical_body.trigger: STA moves to a new AP in the same MD
technical_body.shape: single Reassoc Request/Response pair carries the FTE
attack_surface: KRACK CVE-2017-13082 replays this to reinstall PTK

technical_body.trigger: STA sends Neighbor Report Request; AP responds with list of preferred neighbor BSSIDs
attack_surface: spoofed Neighbor Report steers STA toward rogue BSSID

technical_body.trigger: AP sends BTM Request (WNM Action, category 10, action 7) suggesting STA move to a specific BSSID
technical_body.response: BTM Response with accepted/reject status code
attack_surface: crafted BTM Request from a rogue shoves the STA onto attacker BSSID

technical_body.trigger: STA sends GAS Initial Request with ANQP query IDs; AP responds
technical_body.shape: Action frames (Category 4 Public Action, Action 10=GAS Initial Request / 11=GAS Initial Response)
attack_surface: Realm/Domain string exfil from a puzzle AP

technical_body.trigger: STA with Passpoint profile finds an OSU-advertising AP
technical_body.flow: OSU Server URL from ANQP → HTTPS enrollment → provisioned Passpoint profile
attack_surface: rogue OSU server phishes provisioning credentials
